sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName WHERE {
  ?c1 rc:affects ?v1 . ?v1 rc:ofModel ?m1 . ?m1 rc:name "TELLURIDE" ; rc:ofMake ?mk1 . ?mk1 rc:name "KIA" .
  ?c1 rc:affectsComponent ?comp .
  ?comp rc:name ?cn . FILTER(CONTAINS(?cn, ":"))
  ?c2 rc:affectsComponent ?comp ; rc:affects ?v2 .
  ?v2 rc:ofModel ?m2 . ?m2 rc:name ?modelName ; rc:ofMake ?mk2 . ?mk2 rc:name "GENESIS" .
} ORDER BY ?modelName
SELECT ?modelName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:name ?modelName . } GROUP BY ?m ?modelName ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1
SELECT ?campNo ?pa WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:parkOutside true ; rc:potentiallyAffected ?pa ; rc:campaignNumber ?campNo } ORDER BY DESC(?pa) LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?count) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?i . FILTER(UCASE(STR(?i)) = "ODI" || CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?i)), "ODI")) }

SELECT ?topName (COUNT(DISTINCT ?r) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?mk rc:name "GENESIS" .
  ?m rc:ofMake ?mk .
  ?v rc:ofModel ?m .
  ?r rc:affects ?v .
  ?r rc:affectsComponent ?c .
  ?c skos:broader* ?top .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?top skos:broader ?up }
  ?top rc:name ?topName .
}
GROUP BY ?topName
ORDER BY DESC(?n)

SELECT ?year (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:reportReceivedDate ?d ; rc:affects ?v . ?v rc:ofModel ?m . ?m rc:ofMake ?mk . ?mk rc:name ?mn . FILTER(?mn IN ("HYUNDAI","KIA","GENESIS")) BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ?campno WHERE { ?c a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campno . OPTIONAL { ?c rc:defectSummary ?d } OPTIONAL { ?c rc:affectsComponent/rc:name ?cn } FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?d)),"integrated charging control unit") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?d)),"iccu") || CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?cn)),"iccu")) } ORDER BY ?campno

SELECT DISTINCT ?campno WHERE { ?r a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:campaignNumber ?campno ; rc:defectSummary ?d . FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?d), "connecting rod bearing") && CONTAINS(LCASE(?d), "wear")) } ORDER BY ?campno
